answer: For the 2023-24 Budget Estimates, the allocation for Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 was 15,004.65 crore under Part B and 870 crore under Part A [S1, S2].
The allocation for 'Self Defence for Girls Students in Schools' in Delhi's 2024-25 gender budget was 20,000 thousands [S1].
The allocation for 'Self Defence for Girls Students in Schools' in Delhi's 2026-27 gender budget is 100,000 thousand [S1].
The outlay for Ladli Yojna in Delhi for 2024-25 was 1,000 crore rupees [S1], [S2].

The total gender budget allocation for Odisha in 2024-25 (BE) consists of Rs 1,787,841.23 lakh for gender-specific components (Part A) and Rs 5,774,450.52 lakh for gender-sensitive components (Part B) [S2, S5]. While the number of schemes contributing to the gender-sensitive budget increased by 4% compared to 2023-24 (BE), the total comparative budget figure for the previous year is not provided [S2].
Australia was the first country to undertake gender-responsive budgeting, initiating the process in 1984 [S2].
The grand total of Parts A and B in the Union Budget for 2012-13 was 88,143 crore [S4].
In BE 2013-14, 30 Ministries/Departments and 5 Union Territory governments made allocations for the gender budget statement [S1].

Under the Bihar gender budget 2024-25, the daily rate for nutritional supplements is Rs. 8 per child for normal children, Rs. 12 per day for severely malnourished children, and Rs. 9.50 per day for pregnant or lactating mothers [S2].
दिल्ली के 2026-27 जेंडर बजट में 'लड़कियों में मासिक चक्र स्वच्छता (किशोरी)' योजना के लिए 3,00,000 हजार रुपये का आवंटन प्रस्तावित है [S1]।
बिहार जेंडर बजट 2024-25 के अनुसार, जीविका के अंतर्गत अब तक कुल 10.47 लाख स्वयं सहायता समूह गठित किए गए हैं [S1], [S4]।
